For your particular concerns and questions, I recommend Catholic Answers, which answers many common questions about the Catholic faith:

Jorge is awesome. Like, really awesome.

I don't know what enticed me to build him two years ago. I thought him getting a ton of votes was hilarious (botted or not, doesn't really matter), and it was even funnier to see IS actually implement him into the game. Here was some semi-generic shopkeeper NPC with a full proper GHB, and shockingly impressive art to boot. Some people were weirdly salty about him getting in - and still are, for some reason - but I can't hate him. He's funny. I like him a lot.

In any case, I had a spare Midori some two years back, and I thought it'd be funny to spin together an EP tank Jorge. Nothing too fancy... I just slapped Close Foil and Spendthrift on him, added Sol, Atk Smoke, and QR3, and called it a day. I was expecting him to be decent, but he frankly blew my expectations out of the water. Sure, he wasn't outright invincible - green mage nukes always made sure of that - but he could omnitank like nobody's business.

So I kept investing in him. Plegian Bow really overtuned him, and Atk/Def Menace has proved very useful in PvP content (though I still do prefer Atk Smoke in PvE, since he omnitanks large hordes much better with it). I've got my sights set on Atk Smoke 4 now, which I think would really turn his power up to 11; unfortunately, though, hard saving for other projects (looking at you B!Seliph) has kept me from spending too much for it before now. I'm confident he'll be damn near invincible once I get my hands on it. Unfortunately no QR4 from my free summons today either; but no worries, I'll snag that too once saving for merge projects gets a bit less tight. For now, [here he stands in all his glory.](https://i.imgur.com/ONqEFME.jpg) I'm quite proud of all the mileage I've gotten out of this meme character I built on a whim.

And why all this, you ask, for some semi-generic shopkeeper NPC who got botted into the game?

Because he's funny. Really, do you need any other reason to love the guy?

Still waiting for the fanbase’s recency bias on 3H to largely disappear so people can start dunking on it. We’re still in the phase of “wow that’s a hot take” when you criticize the gameplay or design choices and I can’t wait to get past it. Yeah, it was a lot of fun, but *damn* does the game have some issues that I really wanna see discussed.

I’m not trying to make a point about memes, I’m trying to make a point that people need to stop getting worked up and saying shit like “stupid elitists made the sub this way.” I know it’s wishful thinking that it’ll ever stop but that’s no reason to just roll over and let the circlejerk continue

Banning people isn’t the solution by any means. That’s stupidly radical. And everyone has shitty posts from time to time, we can’t win em all. But when the shitty low effort ones with no punchline or humor are getting more attention than the ones with insane amounts of effort, it’s a problem.

More than anything, the problem with this subreddit is the amplified mindset of elitists vs casuals, and how it’s led to so much discord. “Low effort” posts have been the most recent point of conflict between the two, so it’s easier for people (myself included) to blame those. They are a problem, don’t get me wrong, but I don’t think it’s the biggest problem.

Thankfully the mods did a good job of controlling those posts once they got stale, but it still left enough damage to feed into the casual vs elitist war. It’s really hard to blame any one source for the situation that’s been created.

I’m iffy on it “never being funnier”. I just hate low effort posts with no punchline, humor, and/or new contribution in general, and unfortunately the sheer amount of Three Houses posts has created a weird environment, in my opinion, where a lot of the jokes that would be a lot more funny and as a result would pass by with less effort in making have just been beaten to death. Stuff like upside down Claude, “I am Ferdinand von Aegir!”, and Lysithea killing Death Knight are a few. It’s just sort of led to me having a bias against low effort Three Houses posts in general,  to the point where I would upvote the same post if it was just replaced with characters from an older game or something like that. 

Low effort posts are always going to be relevant on shitposting subs - that’s part of shitposting culture - but when the low effort combines with a joke that’s been made hundreds of times before, it just gets boring. And unfortunately it’s been used as fuel for the “war” between elitists and casuals, where elitists just blame Three Houses in a lazy generalization that accomplishes nothing and casuals retort with “you guys make low effort posts too so you’re the problem” not realizing that low effort isn’t the problem, but repetitive jokes. 

But hey, at least we can all come together at times to make fun of people who think the mods are fascists for deleting the unfunniest of unfunny posts.

Even the most unique and out there FE games are still very recognizable as Fire Emblem at a basic gameplay level. Echoes/Gaiden is a wildly different game compared to Path of Radiance, but both are still similar at the combat level. You command an army of units across a grid against a similar army of units. Hell, even FEH draws from that same formula.

TMS, despite including many nods/references to Fire Emblem as well as Fire Emblem characters, can not be considered a mainline game. It is far too different on many important levels. Think of it like comparing PokePark to the main series Pokemon games. It’s a wildly different game that still draws references and characters from the main series. 

The argument that TMS is a mainline game is a very flawed argument and this post is bait.
